verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs say users can export their information from the 1Password apps to move it to another app, so a first-party exit path exists. The evidence never names the export formats, so the 'open formats' part is unverified. The pack also doesn't show that 'all' data types are covered, and a community report says export was limited to the desktop apps, forcing a Linux user to run a Windows VM to get their data out. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), evidence that export covers all item types and attachments, export across all platforms, and independent confirmation of a clean migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
